nodes.title: Impulse exhaustion
nodes.summary: A real-time state in which directional progress becomes harder to sustain; it is not a hindsight-defined terminal pivot.

nodes.title: Price response efficiency
nodes.summary: Directional price progress per unit of contemporaneous aggressive flow, measured using only information available at time t.

nodes.title: Aggressive trade flow
nodes.summary: Signed buyer- versus seller-initiated traded quantity over a declared event or clock-time window.

nodes.title: Passive liquidity absorption
nodes.summary: Resting or replenishing liquidity absorbs aggressive orders so flow remains directional while price progress decays.

nodes.title: Mechanical volatility normalization
nodes.summary: An apparent response collapse can arise from scale choice, volatility change, or denominator growth without participant-level absorption.

nodes.title: Price-insensitive forced-flow dislocation
nodes.summary: Constrained or externally motivated flow can overwhelm available liquidity and temporarily dislocate price, while competing traders pull impact forward and compress the opportunity.

nodes.title: Diminishing response predicts failed continuation
nodes.summary: Conditional on an active directional impulse, falling price response to continued same-side aggressive flow predicts lower near-horizon continuation than matched baselines.

nodes.title: Matched event-time response-decay test
nodes.summary: Illustrative leakage-safe design comparing continuation after response decay with volatility-, trend-, spread-, and impulse-matched controls.

nodes.title: Illustrative supportive result placeholder
nodes.summary: Synthetic example of how a supportive finding would link to HYP-001; it contains no measured market result.

nodes.title: Illustrative contradictory result placeholder
nodes.summary: Synthetic example of a regime-specific null or opposite result preserved alongside support; it contains no measured market result.

nodes.title: Illustrative BTC trade and quote event stream
nodes.summary: Placeholder data contract for synchronized trades and top-of-book quotes; no dataset is bundled and no quality claims are made.

nodes.title: High-volatility liquid session
nodes.summary: Illustrative conditioning state defined by ex-ante rolling volatility, spread, and depth percentiles rather than future outcomes.

nodes.title: Quiet liquid session
nodes.summary: Illustrative low-volatility conditioning state defined causally from lagged volatility while spread and depth remain liquid.

nodes.title: Flow-shock and response-decay monitor
nodes.summary: Unvalidated MMT prototype with the original live card and halos plus a compact two-sided, magnitude-graded Flow Shock ribbon; response decay remains design-only.

nodes.title: Delta Candle Pressure Divergence v3 port
nodes.summary: Corrected MMT v3 port with graded pressure views, expanded CVD, close-confirmed divergence, causal OHLCV/activity adaptation, and customizable impulse-gated bubbles from historical size-bucket taker flow or exact raw prints.

nodes.title: Flow Shock x Delta Pressure sequence
nodes.summary: Unvalidated MMT v3 prototype that permits one aligned Flow Shock arm per confirmed delta-pressure impulse, then upgrades the event through joint pressure decay and price reclaim states.

nodes.title: Comet speed and density lab
nodes.summary: Unvalidated MMT v3 research indicator with lab and compact graded-ribbon views that keep two-active-second speed, activity, and volume-per-move density inspectable.

nodes.title: Book replenishment and reclaim
nodes.summary: Unvalidated MMT v3 companion for Delta Pressure that tracks consumed-side book stress, recovery, response decay, and price reclaim, with an Aurora HUD and fixed-span right-edge liquidity bands.

nodes.title: Aurora Momo Engine reconstruction
nodes.summary: Source-inspired MMT v3 reconstruction of a horizon-signed momentum and aggressor-flow composite with participation and compression gates in a panel-only Aurora or blue/red presentation.

nodes.title: Aurora Flow Momentum v2
nodes.summary: Panel-only successor with corrected participation gating, composite renormalization, soft saturation, separate activity and signed pressure, response-decay exhaustion, adaptive compression, and optional component diagnostics.

nodes.title: Response-decay trade-avoidance rule
nodes.summary: Illustrative strategy concept that suppresses momentum entries during response decay; no edge or profitability is claimed.

nodes.title: Raw delta divergence as standalone reversal edge
nodes.summary: Example rejection record: raw divergence alone lacks a stable event definition, independent information test, and execution-aware evidence.

nodes.title: Naive cross-venue perp funding capture as a standalone edge
nodes.summary: Source-reported failure in which noisy relative-funding forecasts, basis complexity, fees, execution, and balance fragmentation erased apparent perp-perp carry profits.

nodes.title: Does response decay transfer across venues?
nodes.summary: Determine whether any effect survives exchange-specific trade classification, fees, latency, and liquidity structure.

nodes.title: Does joint speed and density identify scalpable impulses?
nodes.summary: Test whether price-velocity and trade-intensity acceleration jointly identify executable short-horizon opportunity, and whether volume-per-move distinguishes absorption from thin displacement.

nodes.title: Does consumed-side depth recovery predict LTF reversal?
nodes.summary: Test whether consumed-side depth retreat followed by persistent replenishment during continued taker pressure predicts failed continuation or reversal at executable prices.
